title: All-electrical dephasing-protected spin qubits in altermagnets
summary: We propose altermagnetic semiconductors as a platform for field-free, all-electrically controlled spin qubits in gate-defined quantum dots. The momentum-dependent spin splitting of an altermagnet produces a Zeeman-like qubit splitting whose magnitude and sign are set by the dot ellipticity, enabling local frequency tunability without external magnetic fields or micromagnets.
